DesignSystem.title: Visual system
DesignSystem.description: Paper, ink, and one accent. Tokens and components for this stage. This is not a public portfolio section.
DesignSystem.colorDescription: Light and dark share these names. The accent is pine on paper and sage on charcoal.
DesignSystem.typeDescription: Newsreader carries the voice. Geist carries the interface. Geist Mono carries metadata, in uppercase with tracking.
DesignSystem.sampleTitle: Products with an editorial point of view
DesignSystem.sampleBody: Geist carries the reading text, with a 66-character measure and open leading.
DesignSystem.sampleSmall: Interface text and buttons use the small step.
DesignSystem.sampleItalic: Italic stays reserved for the editorial voice.
DesignSystem.spacingDescription: A 4px base, the same one Tailwind utilities use. Section, gutter, and container are layout tokens.
DesignSystem.layoutGutter: Side gutter. It grows from md.
DesignSystem.breakpointsDescription: Content stays within 72rem. From md, navigation sits on one row.
DesignSystem.bpXl: Wide margins. The container does not grow.
DesignSystem.bp2xl: Same column. Only the outer margin changes.
DesignSystem.radiusDescription: Buttons, cards, and sections stay square. The short radius is for labels. Shadow only lifts the surface off the paper.
DesignSystem.statesDescription: Hover, active, and focus last 200ms. Focus is a 2px ring. Disabled lowers opacity and leaves the tab order.
DesignSystem.navigationDescription: Navigation composes the mark, the links, LanguageSwitcher, and ThemeToggle. This specimen is not the site bar.
DesignSystem.projectDescription: ProjectCard uses surface, a rule, labels, and the short shadow.
DesignSystem.projectSummary: Sample summary for checking measure, rhythm, and labels. It does not describe a real project.
DesignSystem.socialDescription: SocialLinks uses the same quiet link as navigation and the language switcher.
